post.description: Finding products sold in the Netherlands and their lowest prices by keyword, then narrowing: call once, pick a category from `categories` and/or values from `filters`, and call again with `category_id`, `filters` (param -> value or values), `sort`, `min_price`, `max_price`. Take product_id into product for the per-shop offers.

category_id.description:
Pricewatch category id from `categories` (or a category filter value). Reads that category's listing, which offers its specification filters.

Provider reference: minimum 1.

filters.description: Chosen filters as Tweakers query parameters, passed through untouched: keys are a returned filter's `param`, `min_param` or `max_param`, values one of its `values[].value` (or an array of them for checkbox filters; for range filters any value on the filter's scale). Example: {"b": ["122", "1006"], "f764": "13263", "i763": "6.1"}.

max_price.description:
Highest price in whole euros (Tweakers' `pa`).

Provider reference: minimum 0; maximum 100000.

min_price.description:
Lowest price in whole euros (Tweakers' `pi`).

Provider reference: minimum 0; maximum 100000.

page.description:
Result page, 40 products per page.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 50; default 1.

query.description: Search keywords as typed in the Pricewatch search box, e.g. 'iphone 15' or 'rtx 5070'. Optional when category_id is given.

sort.description:
Result order (Tweakers' sort menu): most viewed, price low to high, price high to low, user score, newest or oldest available. Default is Tweakers' own order.

Provider reference: allowed values ["popularity", "price_asc", "price_desc", "rating", "newest", "oldest"].

200.description:
Search Tweakers Pricewatch, the Dutch price comparison site, by keyword and/or category and return one page of up to 40 products: Pricewatch product id, name, spec line, lowest price in EUR, number of shops, user rating and product URL. Also returns the filters the page offers (id, label, type, the Tweakers query parameter names and the values with counts) so a follow-up call can pass chosen values back in `filters`, plus the category facet. With `category_id` the program reads that category's listing, which adds its specification filters (screen size, storage, ...). Sort and min/max price are separate inputs. Pages 1-50.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `categories` | object[] | Category facet of the query: Pricewatch categories with their number of matching products. Tweakers does not print the category on each result row. |
| `category_id` | number | The category whose listing was read, or null for the Pricewatch search. |
| `count` | number |  |
| `country` | string |  |
| `currency` | string |  |
| `filters` | object[] | Filters this page offers, from Tweakers' own filter markup. Pass `param` (checkbox/select) or `min_param`/`max_param` (range/date) as keys of the `filters` input. Specification filters appear only with category_id. |
| `has_more` | boolean | Tweakers links a next result page. |
| `next_page` | number |  |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `page` | number |  |
| `query` | string |  |
| `results` | object[] |  |
| `url` | string | The Tweakers page that answered, with every parameter applied. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
